one_liner: Low-code platform for building collaborative apps, databases, and workflows

evidence.claim: Personal access tokens are the primary auth credential and are self-serve on all plans
evidence.quote: Personal Access Tokens (PATs) allow users to create multiple access tokens that allow for a wide range of access to the information held in Airtable bases

evidence.claim: PATs are available on the free tier; legacy API keys were fully deprecated Feb 1, 2024 in favor of PATs and OAuth
evidence.quote: All users should migrate to Personal Access Tokens for individual use and OAuth for third-party integrations.

evidence.claim: The API uses token-based bearer authentication via the Authorization header
evidence.quote: The Airtable Enterprise API uses token-based authentication like [Airtable's Web API](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction). All requests should send the access token in the Authorization header.

evidence.claim: Free sign-up gives access to the documented Web API
evidence.quote: Airtable is a low-code platform for building collaborative apps. Customize your workflow, collaborate, and achieve ambitious outcomes. Get started for free.

evidence.claim: Airtable officially ships and documents its own MCP server for AI-tool integration
evidence.quote: Airtable's MCP server lets you connect AI tools directly to your Airtable bases. This integration allows you to ask questions about your data, create and update records, and analyze information

notes: Legacy user API keys fully deprecated Feb 1, 2024; use PATs (individual) or OAuth (third-party). Enterprise/admin API endpoints (audit logs, user management) require Enterprise Scale plans. Official MCP server documented at airtable.com/developers/agents/mcp with OAuth and PAT setup paths; some enterprise orgs require admin allow-listing of third-party integrations. Record creation limited to 10 records per request; standard rate limits apply.
